Open and Closed Sets

A set UUU is open when every point is an interior point — each point can be wrapped in an ε\varepsilonε-ball. Move the point xxx and the radius ε\varepsilonε on the line and watch whether the ball stays inside.

U open   ⟺  ∀x∈U ∃ε>0:(x−ε,x+ε)⊆UU \text{ open } \iff \forall x \in U\ \exists \varepsilon > 0 : (x - \varepsilon, x + \varepsilon) \subseteq UU open ⟺∀x∈U ∃ε>0:(x−ε,x+ε)⊆U
F closed   ⟺  Fc openF \text{ closed } \iff F^c \text{ open}F closed ⟺Fc open
